_comment: Owners file of push PP-B (Plant palette redesign: one palette page, the /palette/ move and the honest states) of the Consortium v2 plan (knowledge/project/consortium-v2-plan.md section 'Plant palette redesign'; detail in knowledge/project/plant-palette-slices.md and knowledge/architecture/plant-palette-architecture.md). Supersedes scripts/plan/f1a-owners.json. Path -> stream per chunk: one owner per path per chunk; a path may change hands between chunks (store.ts main -> b2 -> b3 -> main; state/restore.ts main -> b1a; App.tsx main -> b2; suggest.ts main -> b1a -> b1b; print main -> b2; views/place/** main -> b1a -> b1b). Patterns are repo-relative: '*' stays within a folder, '**' crosses folders. Chunks run in order; streams inside a chunk run in parallel (at most two building agents). Streams by feature: b1a your place, arriving and sharing (chunk 1); b2 the palette page and its shell (chunk 1); b1b the pool count into Place and Suggest's gain on holes (chunk 2, needs b2's verdict engine and holes); b3 your plants and things to weigh only (chunk 2, after b2). Amended 2026-11-14 by the owner's 'Delete first' (decision rows 'Delete first' and 'Plant palette delete-first amendments'): chunk 0 also deletes the old screens and their tests (commit 0a'), so the streams lose their deletion duties. Amended 2026-11-14 by the plan recheck (blockers 1 and 2: views/kit/sheet.tsx in chunk 0, b3 owns App.tsx, Palette.tsx, later.ts and later-chunk.ts) and the look-ahead check. 'shared' lists the locale files: each listed stream adds keys only under its own prefix and changes or deletes only the keys its edits name (owners.mjs check against the chunk base); the merge agent joins the blocks. Markers owned by later pushes, and PP-B markers that would fail for another reason after chunk 0, are parked (removed from the tree in chunk 0, listed in scripts/plan/parked-markers.json, restored from 648baf2 by their owner), so the master zero-marker gate holds at the push. node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check <chunk> <stream> <base> --file scripts/plan/pp-b-owners.json fails a stream diff outside its rows. A file found needed mid-build is requested from the main agent, never taken. Amended 2026-11-14 by the 0a' independent check (scratchpad delete-first-check, 18 findings): fitPool stays (Add and Swap read it); View keeps 'matrix' as the empty palette slot so 0a' edits no b1a file; Suggest's kept becomes the members seed; warningCounts stays; the orphaned locale keys added to main's edits; PoolSlot.tsx and views/kit/icons.tsx in chunk 0; consortium-print.test.mjs to b2; four pool-panel tests to b1b in chunk 2; browser-tests.test.mjs and shards.json to b3 in chunk 2 (it registers pp-b3). Amended 2026-11-14 at commit 0b: scripts/homepage.test.mjs joins main's chunk-0 files (it pins the owner's tool name per locale, which the 'Plant palette' rename changes). Amended 2026-11-15 by the chunk 2 drift check at f96f81f: store.ts b3 -> b1b in chunk 2; b1b granted suggest-wait.ts, location-fixtures.mjs, consortium-pp-b2.test.mjs and the count-line CSS.
